This plugin h"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"as zero external dependencies: clone it and it runs, with no build step |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Privacy and security"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Boundary | How it is handled |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| **Local first** | Scanning, parsing, retrieval and Q&A; all happen on your machine; the plugin its"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"elf **makes no network requests** |
| **Sensitive files are never read** | When `.env`, private keys"},{"id":"p19s3","text":", credential files and the like match a sensitive rule, only a `stat` is done to register the path a"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"nd kind; the contents never enter memory, cache or reports |
| **LLM off by default** | `llm.enabled"},{"id":"p19s5","text":": false` is the default. Unless you turn it on explicitly, no code fragment is ever sent to a model "},{"id":"p19s6","text":"|
| **When the LLM is on** | Only the minimal context needed to generate narrative is sent; the resp"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"onse goes through the validator first (paths / line numbers / symbols must really exist), failing cl"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"aims are dropped and counted, and the report states how many were dropped |
| **Write scope** | Only"},{"id":"p19s9","text":" the target project's `.project-compass/` (machine state) and `docs/project-compass/` (human artifac"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"ts); no business code is ever modified |
| **Zero dependency surface** | No npm dependencies, no ins"},{"id":"p19s11","text":"tall scripts, no build output, so there is no supply-chain surface to introduce |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**The machine-state directory ignores itself.** On first write the plugin drops a `.gitignore` whose"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" rule is `*` into
`<project>/.project-compass/`, because `scan.json` / `ir.json` / `state.json` reco"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"rd the **absolute project root** —
that is, your local filesystem layout. `git add .` therefore does"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" not commit it even if you have configured nothing.
Delete that file if you deliberately want to ver"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"sion the state. It is only written when missing, so it never
overwrites content of your own."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The full explanation and the vulnerability reporting process are in **SECURITY.md**."}],"truncated":true}
